# The Super Dentists

> A multi-location pediatric and orthodontic dental practice in San Diego led by Dr. Kami Hoss and Dr. Nazli Keri, offering comprehensive dental care with state-of-the-art technology.

The Super Dentists operates 6 locations across San Diego County and surrounding areas, specializing in pediatric dentistry, orthodontics, and preventive care for children and teens. The practice emphasizes a unique, patient-centered approach with advanced technology like iTero scanners and clear aligners.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Braces and clear aligners
- Dr. Kami Hoss
- Dr. Nazli Keri
- San Diego dental care
- Teeth straightening
- Oral hygiene
- Sedation dentistry
- Dental sealants
- Early orthodontic treatment
- Insurance accepted
- Teen and adult dentistry
- Dental technology (iTero)
- Multiple San Diego locations
